errores.producto_con_color: The product already sells in that colour: choose it from the colour list.
errores.atributo_invalido: One of the values does not fit its attribute: a colour that is not in the palette, or a value outside the allowed ones.
errores.imagen_producto_invalida: The gallery changed in the meantime: reload the page and move it again.
errores.monto_de_reintegro_invalido: The amount does not fit in what is left to refund for this order.
errores.reintegro_requerido: The refund amount or method is missing, and this outcome returns money.
errores.retracto_ya_radicado: This order already has a withdrawal in progress.
errores.pedido_sin_entregar: This order has not been delivered yet.
errores.existencia_insuficiente: There is no longer enough stock for this operation.
errores.linea_no_es_del_pedido: That product is not part of this order.
errores.transicion_de_estado_invalida: That step is not possible from the current state. Reload and check again.
errores.metodo_de_pago_no_es_transferencia_manua: This order was not paid by transfer, so it cannot be reconciled by hand.
errores.contraentrega_no_disponible: Cash on delivery is not available for this order.
errores.excepcion_de_dominio: The operation breaks a business rule and the server does not say which. Check the data again.
errores.sesion_de_refresco_invalida: Your session expired. Sign in again: retrying will not help.
errores.limite_de_intentos_excedido: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a few minutes before trying again.
errores.guia_no_encontrada: There is no shipment with that tracking number.
errores.emision_no_encontrada: That label purchase no longer exists.
errores.producto_sin_imagen_principal: This product has no main image, and it cannot be published without one.
errores.galeria_llena: The gallery is full. Remove an image before adding another one.
errores.imagen_de_galeria_duplicada: That same image is already in the gallery.
errores.imagen_de_galeria_no_encontrada: That image is no longer in the gallery.
errores.producto_publicado: It is published: take it off the storefront before deleting it.
errores.producto_con_ventas: It has sales, so it cannot be deleted. Take it off the storefront instead: orders, warranties and withdrawals still need it.
errores.proveedor_no_encontrado: That supplier no longer exists. Reload the list.
errores.proveedor_inactivo: The supplier is inactive. Activate it from its page before uploading an export.
errores.proveedor_de_listas: This is a technology supplier: its catalog comes in through the price list, not through the chat export.
errores.proveedor_sin_listas: This supplier is not a technology supplier: its catalog comes in through the chat export, not through a price list.
errores.lista_de_tecnologia_desactualizada: That list is older than the last one imported: only import a list from that date or later.
errores.lista_de_tecnologia_ya_importada: That list was already imported with this same content: repeating it would restock what was sold.
errores.proveedor_con_productos: The supplier has products in the catalogue. Deactivate it instead of deleting it.
errores.proveedor_con_ingesta_en_curso: The supplier has an export being processed. Wait for it to finish and try again.
errores.exportacion_no_encontrada: The file did not reach the bucket. Pick it again and upload once more.
errores.exportacion_demasiado_grande: The export is too large. Export the chat without media or split the period in two.
errores.tipo_de_exportacion_no_admitido: That file is not a chat export. Upload the .zip WhatsApp generates.
errores.cola_de_ingestas_llena: Too many imports are running and this one did not make it into the queue. Upload the export again in a while.
errores.lote_no_encontrado: That import no longer exists: the list was just refreshed.
errores.borrador_no_encontrado: That draft no longer exists. Reload the list.
errores.borrador_no_editable: This draft has already been decided: it cannot be changed or approved again.
errores.borrador_no_eliminable: An approved draft or a renewal cannot be deleted while its product exists: it is what recognizes the product when the supplier posts it again.
errores.borrador_sin_fotos: A product cannot be approved without photos. If the post had none, reject it.
errores.borrador_sin_precio: The sale price is missing. Enter it before approving.
errores.producto_sin_descripcion: The product description is missing: it is what the product page says.
errores.borrador_sin_descripcion: The product description is missing. Write it in the extracted data before approving.
errores.borrador_sin_titulo: The product title is missing. Fix it in the extracted data before approving.
errores.atributo_de_catalogo_no_definido: The colour or size attributes are missing from the catalogue. Create them before approving.
errores.foto_no_es_del_borrador: One of the photos does not belong to this post. Reload the page.
errores.prenda_incoherente: A garment has no colour or has photos of two colours. Check the garment of each photo.
errores.imagen_de_proveedor_ilegible: One of the photos could not be processed. Reject it or ask the supplier for the photo again.
errores.producto_de_proveedor_ya_existe: This post is already a product in the catalogue: same title at the same price. Reject the draft.
errores.lote_en_curso: The import is still running or paused. Stop it, or wait for it to finish, before deleting it.
errores.archivo_de_ingesta_en_uso: An import that reads this file is still running or paused. Wait for it to finish, or stop it, to delete the file.
errores.archivo_de_ingesta_no_encontrado: The file no longer exists. Reload the list.
errores.pago_sin_pedido_ya_devuelto: That payment already has its refund recorded.
errores.inventario_sin_confirmar: There is no stock for every line: restock and try again, or cancel with a refund.
errores.peso_de_referencia_no_admitido: That category does not take a reference weight: it is electronics, which is measured product by product, or it has subcategories, and the weight goes on each of them.
errores.articulo_sin_medidas: An item in this order has no measurements and its category has no reference weight. Measure it, or set a weight for its category in "Shipping weights and sizes".
errores.articulo_no_asegurable: A package in this order is worth more than the carrier insures, so it cannot be shipped.
errores.talla_repetida: That model already has that size in one of its colors: two variants would be identical.
errores.marca_con_productos: This brand has products. Move them to another brand from their form before deleting it.
errores.marca_ya_existe: There's already a brand with that name. Different capitalisation doesn't make it a different one.
errores.marca_no_encontrada: That brand no longer exists: the list has just been refreshed.
errores.lote_en_otro_estado: The import changed state in the meantime (it finished, failed or was stopped). The list has just been refreshed.

iniciarSesion.no_es_admin: This account doesn't have access to the panel.
iniciarSesion.error_demasiados_intentos: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a few minutes and try again - your password is not the problem.

sinMedir.aviso: {{total}} catalog variant(s) have no package measurements, {{publicados}} of them on published products. Clothing, footwear and bags are quoted with their category's average weight; electronics, and anything in a category without a weight, cannot be delivered to an address, and with store pickup off it is not sold on the site.

existencias.aviso: {{total}} catalog variant(s) have not a single unit in the inventory ledger, {{publicados}} of them on published products. Anyone seeing them in the shop sees them sold out.

pedidos.sin_pedidos_en_estado: No orders in that status. Try "All".

plazo_entrega.sin_aviso: Not notified yet. The watcher checks every twelve hours.
plazo_entrega.que_sigue: Terminating the contract is the buyer's decision. If they ask for it, cancel the order with the reason “deadline missed”.
plazo_entrega.que_sigue_despachado: This order has already shipped and cannot be cancelled: from shipped the only ways out are delivery or rejection on delivery. If the buyer wants to terminate the contract, the return has to be arranged with the carrier.

detalle.imprimir_etiqueta: Print label (opens in a new tab)

acciones.emision_en_curso: We asked {{transportadora}} for {{paquetes}} label(s). There is no tracking number yet: the order only moves to shipped once the carrier answers, in a few minutes.
acciones.guia_por_fuera: Or record a tracking number created elsewhere
acciones.transportadora_elegida: The buyer chose {{transportadora}}: create the label with that carrier.
acciones.comision_recaudo_requerida: Enter the fee the bank charged. If it charged none, enter 0.
acciones.motivo_requerido: Enter the reason: it stays in the order history.
acciones.transportadora_requerida: Enter the carrier for this shipment.
acciones.costo_envio_requerido: Enter what this shipment cost. If you do not know yet, enter 0 and fix it later.
acciones.pagado_sin_inventario: The payment arrived after the reservation expired and there was no stock. Once you restock, confirm it to prepare it; if there will be none, cancel it with a refund.
acciones.guia_en_plataforma: The label is created by hand in Skydropx (Quote and create) with the packages below, and recorded here with its number.

pagos_sin_pedido.ayuda: Payments approved when their order no longer expected them: the buyer paid twice, or the order was already cancelled or failed. That money belongs to no sale and is refunded in full. Refund it in the gateway (or ask Sistecrédito to cancel the credit) and record the receipt here.

devolucion.ayuda: When the rejected parcel is back at the warehouse: the unit goes back on sale and, if the order had been paid, the refund is recorded and the buyer is notified.
devolucion.por_devolver: Refunded in full, product and shipping:
devolucion.sin_dinero: This order had not been paid, so there is no money to refund.

cancelacion.ayuda: On our side and before dispatch: the product became unavailable, or we did not deliver within the agreed time.
cancelacion.dinero_ayuda: This order had already been paid, so cancelling it requires refunding. It cannot be cancelled without an amount.
cancelacion.sin_dinero: Nothing had been charged for this order yet, so there is nothing to refund.

motivos.plazo_incumplido: We did not deliver on time

productos.sin_productos: There are no products yet. Create the first one with "New product".

crear.faltanCampos: Required fields are missing: name, description, brand and category.
crear.error: Couldn't create the product. Try again.
crear.faltaMarca: Brand missing? Create it (anything typed here is lost)

editar.faltanCampos: Required fields are missing: the name, the description, the brand and the category.
editar.descripcionObligatoria: Write the description: it is what the product page says about the product.
editar.sirveHastaAyuda: The largest size this one-size garment fits. Leave it blank if unknown.
editar.variantesAyuda: Each one with its SKU and what sets it apart. Add them with “Add variant”.
editar.error: Couldn't edit the product. Try again.

imagenPrincipal.faltanCampos: The file or one of the two alternative texts is missing.
imagenPrincipal.archivo: Choose an image (JPEG, PNG or WebP)
imagenPrincipal.tipoNoSoportado: That file type isn't supported. Use JPEG, PNG or WebP.
imagenPrincipal.error: Couldn't upload the image. Try again.

colorNuevo.titulo: New colour for the main photo
colorNuevo.ayudaConColores: The product starts selling in this colour: one variant is created for each size, with the price and packaging of the one that already exists in that size. Each size starts with one unit; change it if there are more, or enter zero to show it as sold out.
colorNuevo.ayudaSinColores: The product has no colour yet: its variants take the one you choose, with the units they already have.
colorNuevo.unidadesInvalidas: Enter a whole number, zero or more.
colorNuevo.faltanDatos: The colour or the units of some size are missing.
colorNuevo.error: The colour could not be added. Try again.

galeria.ayudaColor: Mark which colour each photo shows: the card and the product page show it when that colour is chosen.
galeria.errorColor: The photo colour could not be saved. Try again.
galeria.faltanCampos: The file or one of the two alternative texts is missing.
galeria.ayuda: Up to {{tope}} images, on top of the main one. They appear on the product page in this order, and you can change it.
galeria.vacia: This product has no gallery images. The product page shows only the main one.
galeria.archivo: Add an image (JPEG, PNG or WebP)
galeria.previsualizacion: Preview of the image to add
galeria.subirImagen: Move gallery image {{posicion}} up one place
galeria.bajarImagen: Move gallery image {{posicion}} down one place
galeria.reordenada: The gallery is in its new order.
galeria.errorReordenar: Couldn't change the order. Try again.
galeria.loQueImplicaQuitar: It leaves the product page and its file is deleted. There's no undo: to get it back you have to upload it again.
galeria.tipoNoSoportado: That file type isn't supported for the gallery. Use JPEG, PNG or WebP.
galeria.error: Couldn't add the image. Try again.
galeria.errorQuitar: Couldn't remove the image. Try again.
galeria.agregada: The image was added to the gallery.
galeria.usarComoPrincipalImagen: Use image {{posicion}} as the main image
galeria.principalCambiada: The chosen photo is now the main image. If there was another one, it took its place in the gallery.
galeria.errorPrincipal: We could not change the main image. Please try again.

publicacion.borrador: It is a draft: it is not shown in the store.
publicacion.publicado: It is published: anyone can see it in the store and buy it.

eliminar.explicacion: Removes it from the catalog with its variants, stock and photos. Only a draft product that has never been sold can be deleted.

tallas.ayuda: Correcting a size changes it in every color of that model. The SKU stays the same, and existing orders keep the size they were bought in.
tallas.faltaTalla: Choose or type the new size.
tallas.error: The size could not be changed. Try again.

agregarVariante.paqueteAyuda: Measure the product once packed. The shipping cost is calculated from this: if the weight is lower than the real one, the carrier will recalculate the charge later.
agregarVariante.pesoAlto: That weight is over 8 kg, and above that some carriers stop quoting: the ceilings measured on the account are 8, 25, 60, 150, 200 and 500 kg depending on the carrier. If the product does not really weigh that, check that you typed grams.
agregarVariante.colorAyuda: Tick up to three, in order: the first one you tick goes on the left of the circle. “Black” then “Red” is “Black / Red”.
agregarVariante.error: Couldn't add the variant. Try again.
agregarVariante.faltanCampos: Some required fields are missing. Check the highlighted fields and try again.

sinMedir.explicacion: A variant without weight and dimensions is still sold. If it is clothing, footwear or a bag, its shipping is quoted with its category's average weight ("Shipping weights and sizes"); if it is electronics, or its category has no weight, it cannot be delivered to an address, and with store pickup off it is not sold on the site. Measurements are those of the packed product, not the bare product.
sinMedir.resumen: {{total}} without measurements, {{publicados}} on already published products.
sinMedir.medida: Done: {{sku}} now has its measurements and home delivery can be quoted.
sinMedir.errorLista: The list of variants without measurements could not be loaded.
sinMedir.paqueteAyuda: Of the packaged product, box and accessories included. Weight in grams, dimensions in whole centimeters.
sinMedir.faltanCampos: All four measurements are required, and all greater than zero.
sinMedir.error: The measurements could not be saved.

existencias.explicacion: Two figures per variant, and they are not the same. The ledger one is what there is, because it is the sum of every movement; the available one is that minus whatever is already committed to orders in progress, and it is the one that decides whether the shop allows buying. Counting writes an adjustment movement with its reason: the number is not edited, it is corrected.
existencias.resumen: {{total}} active variant(s), {{sinExistencia}} without a single unit in the ledger.
existencias.ninguna: There are no active variants to count yet.
existencias.conteoAyuda: Enter how many units are actually in the warehouse, not the difference. Zero is a valid count. The reason is kept in the history and is what whoever reviews this adjustment in six months will read.
existencias.faltanCampos: The counted units or the reason are missing. The reason is required: an adjustment without one cannot be audited.
existencias.error: The count could not be saved.
existencias.errorLista: The stock list could not be loaded.
existencias.sinCambios: No change: {{sku}} is still at {{unidades}} units. No movement was recorded.
existencias.reservasSinRespaldo: Careful: {{reservadas}} units of {{sku}} are committed to orders in progress, more than you just counted. Those purchases are already accepted and will not be shippable.

medidas.explicacion: Every active variant with the weight and dimensions of its box, whether it has them or not. Without all four figures, electronics cannot be quoted or delivered to an address, and with store pickup off they are not sold on the site; clothing, footwear and bags are quoted with the averages in "Shipping weights and sizes", and measuring them here only refines the shipping cost. A measurement already taken can be corrected: if it is wrong, the wrong shipping cost is charged on every order of that variant.
medidas.ninguna: There are no active variants in the catalogue yet.
medidas.errorLista: We could not load the measurements. Please try again.
medidas.paqueteAyuda: The product already packed, in whole grams and centimetres rounded up. Measuring short means losing the difference on every shipment; measuring long scares buyers away with a shipping cost that is not real.
medidas.avisoCorreccion: This variant already had measurements. Correcting them does not change orders already quoted with the previous ones.
medidas.faltanCampos: Measurements are missing: the weight and the three dimensions, all greater than zero.
medidas.error: We could not save the measurements. Please try again.

publicar.confirmar: Publish {{nombre}}? It will become visible in the shop.
publicar.error: We could not publish the product. Please try again.
publicar.loQueImplica: The panel can take it down later, but while it is published anyone can buy it.
publicar.loQueImplicaRetirar: It stops showing in the shop, its link answers 404 and it leaves the sitemap. Orders already placed carry on; a cart holding it will fail at checkout.
publicar.errorRetirar: We could not take the product down. Please try again.

eliminar.confirmar: Delete “{{nombre}}” from the catalog? This cannot be undone.
eliminar.loQueImplica: Its variants, stock, photos and 360° viewer go with it. Only a draft product that has never been sold can be deleted.
eliminar.error: We couldn't delete the product. Please try again.

limpiar.explicacion: There are {{cantidad}} unpublished product(s). You can delete them all at once, with their photos.
limpiar.loQueImplica: They are deleted along with their variants, their stock and all their photos, and cannot be recovered. This includes products removed from the storefront and approved technology products still waiting for photos. Published products are not touched, and products that have been sold or have units in stock are kept.
limpiar.error: Not all of them could be deleted. The ones already deleted are gone; try again to finish.
limpiar.hechoConConservados: {{eliminados}} unpublished product(s) deleted. {{conservados}} were kept because they have sales or units in stock.

retractos.no_aplica: Withdrawal only applies to an order that has been delivered.
retractos.ayuda_radicar: The buyer exercises it by email or WhatsApp. This is the record of it.
retractos.esperando_producto: Waiting for the product to come back.
retractos.plazo_restante: {{dias}} calendar days left to refund the money.
retractos.plazo_vencido: The fifteen-day refund deadline has passed.
retractos.medio_preferido_ayuda: Law 2439 of 2024 requires refunding through the medium the buyer prefers. Record it exactly as they asked: it cannot be corrected later.
retractos.preferencia_en_riesgo: The buyer asked for {{medio}}. Refunding through another medium breaches Law 2439 of 2024; if there is a reason, note it in the receipt.
retractos.preferencia_no_respetada: The refund went out through a medium other than the one the buyer asked for.
retractos.error: The action could not be completed. Please try again.

verdicto.indeterminado_ayuda: It was filed when the public-holiday calendar was not loaded: that day it could not be stated that the term had expired, and the verdict stays frozen as it was seen then.

retractos.plazo_restante_uno: 1 calendar day left to refund the money.
retractos.dinero_sin_entrar: Careful: not all the money for this order has come in yet. Refunding is valid, but if the collection never arrives, the loss is double.

atencion.ayuda: Whatever arrives by email or WhatsApp is filed here: it gets a number, an arrival date and a deadline running.
atencion.error: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
atencion.plazo_pasado: The deadline to answer has passed.

radicar.ayuda: The type sets the response deadline, so it cannot be changed later.
radicar.correo: Email of the person filing it
radicar.recibida_en_ayuda: The date on the email or message, not today's: the deadline runs from it. Leave empty if it just arrived.

acciones.prorroga_ayuda: An extension is only valid if notified: recording it sends the notice with these reasons.

verdicto.indeterminado_ayuda: It was filed when the public-holiday calendar was not loaded: that day it could not be stated as missed, and the verdict stays frozen as it was seen then.

garantias.error: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
garantias.ayuda_radicar: The buyer claims it by email or WhatsApp. Filing it gives it a number and a response deadline, like any other request.
garantias.no_aplica: The warranty runs from delivery: it only applies to an order already delivered.

vigencia.indeterminada_ayuda: That category's term is not loaded, so it cannot be stated that the warranty has expired. A person decides.

reversiones.error: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
reversiones.ayuda_radicar: This is not a withdrawal: it applies to fraud, non-delivery, wrong product or a defective one. The buyer must also request it from their payment method issuer.
reversiones.gestion: What was done to facilitate the process

causales.no_corresponde: Does not match what was ordered

verdicto.indeterminado_ayuda: It was filed when the public-holiday calendar was not loaded: that day it could not be stated as missed, and the verdict stays frozen as it was seen then. It can still be filed.

acciones.fecha_ayuda: The day the buyer learned what happened, not the day it happened nor the day they wrote to us: their five business days to request the reversal start there. People find out about fraud later, and with the wrong date the deadline comes out wrong.
acciones.gestion_ayuda: The terms promise to facilitate the process. Without writing down what was done, the promise cannot be proven.
acciones.dinero_ayuda: Only here does money leave us. If the issuer reverses it, the funds return through the payment network.
acciones.monto_del_emisor_ayuda: The amount the issuer returned to the buyer. It does not come out of our own funds, but it counts against what this order can still refund.

revision_envios.ayuda: Whatever is stuck and needs someone to act: tracking numbers that stopped moving and label purchases with money committed. Marking one as reviewed records who looked at it; it does not resolve anything on its own.
revision_envios.vacia: Nothing to review. No stalled shipments and no unresolved label purchases.
revision_envios.error: The action could not be completed.

guias.ayuda: The last movement left these packages stuck. If nobody looks at them, the buyer finds out before the business does.
guias.ya_revisada: Already reviewed on {{fecha}}, and this movement arrived afterwards.

emisiones.ayuda: Money is committed and only a person can decide what happened. Look them up in the carrier panel using the rate identifier.
emisiones.tarifa_ayuda: Use this identifier to find the shipment in the platform panel.
emisiones.no_resuelve: Marking it as reviewed does not resolve it: the order stays blocked for a new label purchase until someone decides what happened with the charge.

estados_emision.sin_anular: Label not voided, may still be live

acciones.ayuda: Who reviewed it and when is recorded. If a new movement arrives afterwards, the shipment comes back to this queue.
acciones.nota_ayuda: Optional. Whoever looks at this next will read it.
acciones.cerrar_guia: Close the review of tracking number {{guia}}
acciones.abrir_emision: Mark the label issue for order {{pedido}} as reviewed

resolucion.titulo: What did you find in the carrier panel?
resolucion.ayuda: Look the shipment up with the rate identifier above. Your answer decides whether the order is free to buy another label or whether we keep tracking the one already paid for.
resolucion.identificadores_ayuda: Only if the shipment does show up. Copy them from the panel; separate several with a comma or a space.
resolucion.con_envio: It is there: track this shipment
resolucion.sin_cobro: Not there: no charge was made
resolucion.falta_identificador: Tracking the shipment needs its identifier. Copy it from the carrier panel.
resolucion.advertencia: If the shipment is not there, the order is free to buy another label. If it is there and you record it, we resume tracking and dispatch happens on its own once the carrier gives the tracking number.
resolucion.abrir_accesible: Resolve the label issue for order {{pedido}}

marcas.explicacion: The catalogue's brands. A new brand is available in the product form straight away. Renaming a brand changes what shoppers see, on the product page and in the store filter. Only a brand with no products can be deleted.
marcas.creada: Done: {{nombre}} is now in the catalogue and shows up in the product form.
marcas.yaExiste: There's already a brand with that name. Different capitalisation doesn't make it a different one.
marcas.error: Couldn't create the brand. Try again.
marcas.errorLista: Couldn't load the list of brands.

editar.hecho: Done: the brand is now called {{nombre}}, in the store too.
editar.error: We couldn't rename the brand. Try again.

eliminar.loQueImplica: It's only deleted if it has no products, in any state. This can't be undone.
eliminar.error: We couldn't delete the brand. Try again.

clave.explicacion: Changing it signs out every other device. This one stays signed in.
clave.exito: Password changed. All other sessions were signed out.
clave.error_formulario: Fill in the three fields and make sure the new password matches.
clave.error_confirmar_clave: The two passwords do not match.
clave.error_clave_actual: That is not your current password.
clave.error_demasiados_intentos: Too many attempts in a row. Wait a few minutes and try again.
clave.error_sesion_expirada: Your session expired. Sign in again and repeat the change.

difusion.explicacion: Post the product's main photo to Facebook or Instagram, with its price and link. The text is drafted from today's data; you can adjust it before sending.
difusion.pieAyuda: Instagram captions cannot hold clickable links: that is why the text points to the bio there instead of printing the URL.
difusion.errorPropuesta: We could not draft the text. Check that the product is published and has a main image.
difusion.faltaPie: Write the post text before sending it.
difusion.yaEnMarcha: That post was just sent. Wait for it to finish before trying again.
difusion.noDifundible: This product can't be shared yet. It has to be published in the store, have at least one active variant and a main image with a JPEG preview; if the image predates that preview, upload it again.
difusion.error: We could not post. Try again.

estado.PENDIENTE: Unconfirmed - check the account before retrying

categorias.explicacion: The catalogue tree. Each business line opens up to two levels: a branch (Women, Men) and its garments. Products always hang from a leaf, never from a branch.
categorias.slugAyuda: Optional. Leave it empty and it is derived from the name. When editing, empty means “leave it as it is”: the slug is in links people already shared.
categorias.hashtagsAyuda: Published with every product in this category. Separate them with spaces or commas; the hash sign is added for you. Empty clears them all.
categorias.padreAyuda: Empty leaves it at the first level, hanging directly from the line.
categorias.lineaAyuda: Only counts if you did not pick a parent category: with a parent, the line is inherited from it.
categorias.lineaVacia: This line has no categories yet.
categorias.faltaLinea: Pick a line, or a category for it to hang from.
categorias.slugRepetido: Another category already uses that slug. Enter a different one.
categorias.tieneProductos: That category has products. Move them elsewhere first.
categorias.tieneSubcategorias: That category has subcategories. Delete or move them first.
categorias.demasiadoProfunda: The catalogue goes two levels below the line. Pick a first-level category.
categorias.ciclo: A category cannot hang from itself or from one of its children.
categorias.error: We could not save the change. Please try again.
categorias.errorLista: We could not load the categories.

colores.maximo: You already ticked three colours, the maximum. Untick one to change it; for more colours, use “Multicolour”.
colores.sinResultados: No colour in the palette has that name.

proveedores.explicacion: The suppliers who send their catalogue over WhatsApp. For each one we keep how they appear in the exported chat (that decides which messages are theirs) and the margin used to suggest the sale price. A supplier with products in the catalogue is not deleted: it is deactivated.
proveedores.errorLista: The supplier list could not be loaded.

formulario.errorCarga: The supplier could not be loaded.
formulario.remitenteAyuda: As it appears before the colon on every line of the exported chat: the name you saved the contact under or, if it is not saved, the name that person set for themselves (WhatsApp writes it as "~ Name"; enter it without the tilde). If the chat only shows their number, the phone above is enough. In a group or a community announcement channel only this sender's messages are read; everyone else's are ignored.
formulario.telefonoAyuda: With country code and no spaces: Colombia's 57 followed by the ten digits of the mobile number.
formulario.margenAyuda: Multiplies the supplier price to suggest the sale price. 1.30 is 30% over cost; it cannot be less than 1.
formulario.ordenAyuda: Check how they post each product in their chat. It only decides which product a photo belongs to when it arrives in the same minute as two prices, because the exported chat has no seconds.
formulario.dosChatsEnUnZip: Uploads both chats in one zip: “{name}.zip” with “{name}.txt” (the general one) and “{name}Men.txt” (the menswear one), plus the photos of both
formulario.publicacionAutomatica: Publish without review (not in effect yet: every draft goes through the panel)
formulario.activo: Active. Unchecked, no exports can be uploaded for it.
formulario.faltanCampos: Missing data: name, name in the chat, phone, line, posting order and a margin of at least 1.
formulario.error: The supplier could not be saved. Try again.

eliminar.explicacion: It is deleted along with everything uploaded for it: exports, messages, photos and drafts. Only possible if no catalogue product came from it; otherwise, deactivate it.
eliminar.loQueImplica: This cannot be undone. If you upload one of their exports again, their listings will come back as new drafts.
eliminar.conProductos: It cannot be deleted: {{productos}} catalogue product(s) came from this supplier. Deactivate it instead.
eliminar.error: The supplier could not be deleted. Try again.

ingestas.explicacion: Each batch is a chat export from a supplier. Upload the zip WhatsApp generates (Export chat, with media); the server reads the messages, groups them into posts and leaves a draft for each new product. Uploading the same chat twice is safe: whatever was already read isn't repeated. Imports run one at a time: while one is running you can pause it (the others wait with it) or stop it, and the queue moves on to the next one.
ingestas.errorLista: The import list could not be loaded.
ingestas.ninguna: No export has been uploaded yet.

resumen.parcial: Stopped before finishing. This is what it got through:

subir.archivoAyuda: In WhatsApp: open the chat › More › Export chat › Include media. Upload the zip as is, without unzipping it.
subir.estructuraDosChats: This supplier uploads both chats in one zip: “{{zip}}”, with “{{general}}” (the general chat), “{{caballero}}” (the menswear one) and the photos of both.
subir.estructuraNoAcordada: The file structure is not the agreed one. It must be named “{{zip}}” and contain exactly two .txt files, “{{general}}” and “{{caballero}}”, along with the photos of each chat.
subir.tipoNoSoportado: That file is not a zip. Upload the one WhatsApp generates when exporting the chat.
subir.faltanCampos: Pick the supplier and the file before uploading.
subir.enCola: Done: {{archivo}} is queued. The table refreshes on its own while it is processed.
subir.error: The export could not be uploaded. Try again.
subir.sinProveedores: There is no active supplier to upload an export for.

eliminar.loQueImplica: Its messages, drafts and file are deleted, along with the products that came from it and are not published. Published or already sold products stay in the store. This cannot be undone, and uploading the same export again turns it into drafts again.
eliminar.hecho: Import deleted. Products deleted: {{eliminados}}. Kept because they are published or sold: {{conservados}}.
eliminar.error: We could not delete the import. Please try again.

ingestas.enPausa: Paused. Queued imports wait until you resume or stop it. A pause does not survive a server restart: if it restarts, the import is closed with an error.
ingestas.deteniendo: Finishing the current post, then it frees the queue.
ingestas.detenidaEnCola: Stopped before it started: nothing was read.

ordenes.loQueImplica: The queue moves on to the next import. What was already processed stays; what's left isn't picked up again: uploading the same file again won't process it, because those messages were already read. To process it in full, delete the import and upload it again.
ordenes.loQueImplicaEnCola: It hasn't started yet: it leaves the queue without reading anything.
ordenes.detenida: The import from {{proveedor}} was stopped. If it was running, it finishes the current post and the queue moves on to the next one.

error.pausar: We couldn't pause the import. Try again.
error.reanudar: We couldn't resume the import. Try again.
error.detener: We couldn't stop the import. Try again.

archivos.explicacion: The .zip files uploaded for imports. Once processed they are never read again: deleting them frees storage and leaves the imports, their drafts and their photos untouched. While an import that reads a file is still running, the file cannot be deleted.
archivos.errorLista: The file history could not be loaded. Try again.
archivos.ninguno: No file has been uploaded yet.

borrar.loQueImplica: Only the .zip file is deleted, and it cannot be recovered. The imports, their drafts and their photos stay as they are.
borrar.error: The file could not be deleted. Try again.

tecnologia.explicacion: The models brought in by the technology supplier's price list. Choose which colors are sold for each configuration and at what price; tomorrow's list will only move the cost and the stock.
tecnologia.errorLista: The models could not be loaded. Try again.
tecnologia.ninguno: There are no models in this status.
tecnologia.completaProducto: New configurations of a product already on sale

detalle.errorCarga: The model could not be loaded. Reload the page.
detalle.completaProducto: This model is already on sale: what you approve here is added to its product.
detalle.ficha: Product sheet prepared by the skill
detalle.explicacion: Check the colors the supplier has for each configuration: each one becomes a variant. A configuration without colors is not sold.
detalle.explicacionSinPaleta: The official palette of this model is unknown: type the colors the supplier has, separated by commas. A configuration without colors is not sold.
detalle.precioIlegible: Type the price in pesos, without decimals: 849.900 or 849900.
detalle.errorGuardar: The selection could not be saved. Try again.

aprobar.explicacion: Creates the product with one variant per checked color. It stays as a draft until it has photos: they come from the model's product sheet folder.
aprobar.explicacionExistente: Adds one variant per checked color to the product.
aprobar.nadaQueVender: Check the colors of at least one configuration: otherwise there is nothing to sell.
aprobar.faltaPrecio: Every configuration on sale needs its sale price, in pesos and without decimals.
aprobar.precioBajoCosto: The sale price of each configuration must be higher than its cost.
aprobar.faltanMarcaYCategoria: Choose the catalog brand and category.
aprobar.error: It could not be approved. Try again.

rechazar.explicacion: Future lists will not propose these configurations again.
rechazar.faltaMotivo: Write the reason for the rejection.
rechazar.error: It could not be rejected. Try again.

borradores.explicacion: What the import understood from each supplier post, awaiting review. Approving creates the product with its variants and photos; rejecting records it with a reason. Renewals do not come through here: if the supplier re-posted something already in the catalogue, only its date is renewed.
borradores.errorLista: The draft list could not be loaded.
borradores.ninguno: There are no drafts with that filter.

alertas.PRECIO_INCONSISTENTE: The price in the text and the one the extraction understood do not match. The text price was kept; check it.
alertas.SIN_PRECIO: The post has no price. It cannot be approved without a sale price.
alertas.TITULO_VACIO: No title could be extracted. Write one before approving.
alertas.TIPO_DESCONOCIDO: The product type was not recognised.
alertas.CONFIANZA_BAJA: The extraction is not confident about what it understood. Review everything carefully.
alertas.SIN_FOTOS: The post has no photos. It cannot be approved without photos.
alertas.PRECIO_CAMBIO: The supplier changed the price of a product that already exists. The supplier price was updated; check the sale price.
alertas.FOTOS_COMPARTIDAS: The message announced several products with the same photos. Keep only the ones of this product and mark its main photo.
alertas.REPLICA: The supplier announces it as a replica (1.1 or AAA). It is published under the Generic brand, with the original brand only in the title, such as “Puma - BMW style T-shirt”. Confirm both before approving.

detalle.errorCarga: The draft could not be loaded.
detalle.sinFotosEditable: The post had no photos. Upload them below to be able to approve it.
detalle.cerrado: This draft has already been decided.

datos.explicacion: What the extraction understood. Fix anything wrong here and save; the approval below starts from this data.
datos.precioSugeridoAyuda: In pesos, no decimals. Comes from the supplier price times the margin; you can adjust it.
datos.sirveHastaAyuda: Only if the supplier wrote “fits up to”. If they did not, leave it blank.
datos.tallasDeLaEscala: Sizes it comes in, from the category scale
datos.fueraDeEscala: Outside the category scale: {{tallas}}. Check whether they belong to this product.
datos.descripcionAyuda: This is what the product page shows. The extraction wrote it from what the supplier said; fix it if needed.
datos.invalidos: The price must be a whole number in pesos and the number of colours a number.
datos.error: The data could not be saved. Try again.

aprobar.explicacion: Creates the published product, with one variant per colour and size, the photos copied into the catalogue and the units you indicate in stock.
aprobar.precioVentaAyuda: The final one, in pesos. Starts from the suggested price.
aprobar.existenciaInicialAyuda: What goes into stock for each colour and size. Zero leaves the product sold out until you count.
aprobar.altEnAyuda: The title in English, with the name the item is sold under in English. Suggested by the extraction; check it.
aprobar.faltaDescripcion: The product description is missing. Write it in the extracted data before approving.
aprobar.prendasAyuda: Each garment is a variant and can have several photos. Setting a colour on a photo makes it a garment; to group it with another photo of the same garment, choose that garment. Two garments of the same colour are numbered: “Negro 1”, “Negro 2”.
aprobar.sinVariantesDeColor: No photo has a colour: the product is published with a single variant without colour.
aprobar.unaSolaPrenda: All photos are the same garment
aprobar.prendaSinColor: Garment {{prenda}} has no colour: choose one on any of its photos, or take its photos out of the garment.
aprobar.faltanCampos: Missing data: brand, category, whole sale price, units (0 or more) and both alternative texts.
aprobar.error: The draft could not be approved. Try again.
aprobar.fotosElegidas: {{elegidas}} of {{maximo}} photos selected. The main photo is the one you mark; if you mark none, the first selected one. Untick the extra ones.
aprobar.sinFotosElegidas: Select at least one photo: without photos there is no product.
aprobar.demasiadasFotos: At most {{maximo}} photos fit: the main one plus eight in the gallery. Untick the extra ones.
aprobar.fotosCompartidas: These photos come from a message with several products: some may belong to the other one. Untick the ones that are not of this product and mark the main one.
aprobar.marcarPrincipalFoto: Mark photo {{numero}} as the main photo
aprobar.marcaLaPrincipal: Mark the main photo of this product: the photos were shared with another one.
aprobar.fotoConTonoFuera: Photo {{numero}} has a colour set but is not included in the product: tick it to include it, or clear its colour.
aprobar.esperaSubida: Wait for the photos to finish uploading before approving.

eliminarFoto.loQueImplica: It stops showing here and does not go into the product. If the post had another product with the same photo, it stays there.
eliminarFoto.error: The photo could not be removed. Try again.
eliminarFoto.loQueImplicaSubida: It stops showing here, does not go into the product, and the file is deleted.

subirFotos.ayuda: JPEG or PNG, one or several. They join the others: you can make them the main photo, set their color or remove them.
subirFotos.tipoNoAdmitido: “{{nombre}}” is not a JPEG or PNG and was not uploaded.
subirFotos.ilegible: “{{nombre}}” could not be opened as an image and was not uploaded.
subirFotos.demasiadoGrande: “{{nombre}}” is larger than allowed and was not uploaded. Make it smaller and try again.
subirFotos.error: “{{nombre}}” could not be uploaded. Try again.

rechazar.error: The draft could not be rejected. Try again.

borrar.explicacion: Rejecting keeps a record of why it was not published. Deleting keeps nothing.
borrar.loQueImplica: The draft, the supplier's messages and their photos are deleted and cannot be recovered. If another draft came from the same message, only this one is deleted and the photos stay. If you upload an export that includes the post again, it will show up again.
borrar.error: The draft could not be deleted. Try again.
borrar.explicacionSinProducto: Its product was already deleted: this draft no longer recognizes anything and only keeps the supplier's messages and photos. Deleting it frees them from the bucket.

limpiar.explicacion: There are {{cantidad}} unapproved draft(s): in review or rejected. You can delete them all at once.
limpiar.loQueImplica: They are deleted along with their messages and their photos in private storage, and cannot be recovered. Approved drafts are not touched. If you upload an export that brings those listings again, they will show up as drafts again.
limpiar.error: Not all of them could be deleted. The ones already deleted are gone; try again to finish.
limpiar.ninguno: None was deleted: someone else is deciding on the remaining ones right now. Reload the page and try again.

referencias_envio.explicacion: Clothing, sports footwear and bags that have not been measured one by one are quoted with these averages: they all go in one bag with the sizes below, and the weight is the sum of each product’s average, rounded up to the next kilogram. Electronics do not use averages: they are measured from the manufacturer’s spec sheet. Changes apply from the next quote.
referencias_envio.error_lista: Weights and sizes could not be loaded. Reload the page.
referencias_envio.medidas_ayuda: The same for all three lines. The carrier charges by volumetric weight, so these sizes usually weigh more than the garment: at 40 × 30 × 10 cm, any bag is quoted as roughly 5 kg.
referencias_envio.sin_medidas: No sizes saved: until they are, no unmeasured product is quoted, and none is sold for home delivery.
referencias_envio.faltan_medidas: A size is missing or set to zero. Enter the length, width and height in centimeters.
referencias_envio.error_medidas: The sizes could not be saved.
referencias_envio.medidas_guardadas: Sizes saved. The next quote already uses them.
referencias_envio.pesos_ayuda: One weight per category, in grams. A category without a weight is not quoted: its unmeasured products are not sold for home delivery. A measured product always uses its own measurements.
referencias_envio.ninguna: There are no clothing, footwear or bag categories yet.
referencias_envio.falta_peso: The weight is missing or set to zero. Enter it in grams.
referencias_envio.error_peso: The change could not be saved.
referencias_envio.peso_quitado: {{categoria}} has no weight now: its unmeasured products are no longer sold for home delivery.
referencias_envio.medida_invalida: Enter the size in centimeters, greater than zero.
referencias_envio.peso_invalido: Enter the weight in grams, greater than zero.

paquetes_guia.error: The packages for this order could not be worked out.
paquetes_guia.ayuda: Create {{cuantos}} package(s) in Skydropx with exactly these figures: they are the same ones the buyer's shipping was quoted with.
paquetes_guia.con_recaudo: Cash on delivery: each declared value already includes its share of the shipping cost, and the sum is what the carrier collects at the door. Enter each one as shown; do not put the order total on every package.
